known_world_facts: Tavi is 18 and works as a junior orbital relay technician.

Aster's orbital relay network is monitored by civilian apprentice technicians. Packet timestamps can drift due to faults. Signal propagation, limited reserves and order of operations remain physically binding.
A six-minute timestamp anomaly does not establish time travel.
Power reserve, signal delay and battery drain must remain consistent.
The technician cannot instantaneously communicate across light-minutes.
An unread packet cannot be used as known evidence.
